paper_anchors: Section 4.1 equations (5)-(6), HTML ids S4.E5 and S4.E6
statement: The normalized empirical KL_inf statistic decomposes exactly as T1,n+T2,n, where the dual-optimization term T1,n is negligible and the iid partial-sum term T2,n supplies the Gaussian fluctuation; Y_n=sqrt(n)(L_n-L) also satisfies the quantified Anscombe condition used at the stopping time.
negative_controls: Replace the empirical optimizer by lambda_star+0.5
Apply the eta gate to the wide delta=0.2 window
scope_warning: The experiment reconstructs the exact algebra and directly tests Lemma A.8 at one assumption-satisfying paper distribution; finite paths do not prove the universal quantifiers for every q.
